big_case.notes: Pro se challenge arising from one homeowner's municipal code-enforcement dispute over a fence/arbor, reaching the Court via summary state writ denials of an interlocutory demurrer ruling. The QPs invoke broad Fourth Amendment doctrine but ask the Court to choose between its own settled lines (Ciraolo/Dow vs. Katz/Kyllo); no split, no amici, no response, denied at first conference without noted dissent. Minimal stakes beyond the litigant.
